headline: President Ruto Endorses Didmus Barasa for Bungoma Governor in 2027
seoTitle: Ruto Endorses Didmus Barasa for Bungoma Governor in 2027
metaDescription: President William Ruto has publicly endorsed Didmus Barasa to contest for the Bungoma gubernatorial seat in the upcoming 2027 general elections.
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto has officially expressed support for Didmus Barasa's 2027 gubernatorial bid in Bungoma.
During a visit to the region, the President also disbursed Ksh195 million in bonus payments to local sugarcane farmers.
The President reiterated that the Nzoia Sugar Company remains public property despite the recent implementation of a leasing agreement.
aiContextParagraph: President William Ruto conducted an official tour of Bungoma County, focusing on both political endorsements and the regional agricultural sector. During his visit, the President publicly declared his support for Didmus Barasa to run for the governorship of Bungoma in the 2027 elections. In addition to these political developments, the President presided over the distribution of Ksh195 million in bonuses to local sugarcane farmers, aiming to bolster the industry's productivity. Addressing concerns regarding the management of regional assets, the President defended the leasing deal for the Nzoia Sugar Company. He stated that the factory would remain firmly under the ownership of the people of Bungoma, refuting claims that the lease agreement might compromise local control. These events highlight the government's ongoing engagement with Western Kenya, balancing electoral politics with agricultural policy interventions and state-led economic development initiatives.
whyItIsViral: The story is tracked by three independent media outlets, reflecting significant interest in regional political alignments and government economic initiatives in Western Kenya.
